title: Franklinn's Hammock Heaven ; outside hot tub opt
description:
Relax in this rustic platform in the woods, made from wood from historic 1848 cabin. Perfect for two hammocks. No electricity. Spring water steps away. Walk the creek and enjoy the quiet. Many hiking paths nearby. Lake access 2 miles away. In door toilet close by but is available only from 7am to 9pm.  You may use the outsidew hot tub ($50 one-time cleaning and set up fee)  located at the main house 0.25 miles away.

Guest access
You'll be able to use the area immediately around the platform and hike to your heart's content.

We are the proud owners of The Fork Inn in 3000 acre Big East Fork Valley. We are in a protected watershed located 19 miles west of Nashville and 10 miles north of Franklin. 

We are honored to be Stewards of Big East Fork Valley and support the nearby Center for Sustainable Stewardship. We enjoy the abundant wildlife and the many nearby creeks and hiking trails.
